_comment: Easter eggs for art.eggs. Players type a word into the Logbook's 'shout into the fog' box. Words are lowercase letters and spaces only.

eggs.text: Somewhere in the fog, a crew starts singing. Badly. (Turn on sound and listen.)
A gull lands on your rail, looks at you, and leaves. Rude.
The customs clerk stamps your hand. It says 'APPROVED'. You did not ask for this.
For a moment every lamp on the horizon flickers at once.
Ship 7 reports the goat is now in charge of the galley.
The oldest captain in the harbour nods slowly. 'Took me forty years,' she says.
Nothing happens. Nothing happens again, a bit closer.

cameo.name: MV Placeholder
lines: Testing, testing. Is this sea on?
Don't mind us, we're just checking the water renders.
Built the lanes, now I sail them.
Every pixel on this ship was argued over.
